metadata.scope_purpose: RECREATIONAL drone flights only — flying for fun, sport, hobby or as a private individual. Camera-equipped drones (DJI Avata 2, Mini 4 Pro, etc.) flown for personal enjoyment are RECREATIONAL, not commercial, as long as the output is not sold, licensed, broadcast, contracted, or used to support a business. This map does NOT cover: commercial operations (CASA RePL/ReOC required), business/freelance filming, contracted inspections/surveys, research, or government use. Where a council rule was sourced from a filming/photography page, the rule is applied to recreational flyers only if the source explicitly covers non-commercial use — otherwise the rule is rec-OPEN and the filming URL is dropped.
metadata.notes: Status legend: open (CASA rules apply), permit (council approval required), ban (prohibited on council land), controlled_airport (within 5.5km of Sydney Airport, additional CASA restrictions apply), unknown (no info found, follow CASA only). Update sources/last_updated when revising.

casa_baseline.scope: Recreational drone flights under 25kg operated for sport, hobby or as a private individual.
rules: Do not fly higher than 120m (400ft) above ground level
Keep drone at least 30m away from other people; never fly over another person
Fly only during daylight hours; do not fly through cloud, fog or smoke
Fly only one drone at a time
Keep the drone within visual line-of-sight

weight_rules.micro_under_250g: No registration required for recreational use. All standard safety rules still apply. Within 5.5km of a controlled airport, max height is 45m.
weight_rules.small_250g_to_2kg: Standard safety rules apply. Must not fly within 5.5km of a controlled airport (e.g. Sydney Airport) without CASA approval.
weight_rules.medium_2kg_to_25kg: Standard safety rules apply. Must not fly within 5.5km of a controlled airport without CASA approval.

casa_baseline.airport_rule: Must not fly within 5.5km of a controlled airport (Sydney, Bankstown, etc.) without CASA approval. If within 1.4km of a helicopter landing site and a helicopter is operating, move drone away and land safely.

nsw_state.scope: All NSW national parks and reserves (NPWS-managed land)
nsw_state.summary: Approval is required to launch, land or operate a drone from within any NSW national park or reserve for recreation. Apply at least 10 days in advance to the relevant NPWS Area Office. Drones are prohibited at drone exclusion areas. Drones prohibited entirely in Kosciuszko National Park (includes ski resorts). Stay 100m from marine mammals.

prohibited_areas: All Council-owned/managed parks, reserves and playgrounds (LGA s.632)
notes: List of prohibited activities in Council parks explicitly includes 'Flying of model aircraft (Including Drones)'.
Enforced via regulatory signage in each park.
Private property and public streets not under Council control may be CASA-only — check site.
Almost all LGA is within 5.5km of Sydney Airport — CASA restrictions apply.

ku_ring_gai_council.summary: Council-managed land (ovals, sportsgrounds, parks, libraries): written council approval required before flying any RPA over council-owned or managed land, per Ku-ring-gai Drone (RPA) Policy. The policy cites CASR Part 101, an 'accredited RPA operator certificate or remote pilot licence', and public liability insurance — these are commercial credentials, so the rec carve-out is currently unclear and an email has been sent seeking confirmation (2026-08-09). Separate rule: large portions of the LGA fall within Ku-ring-gai Chase National Park (NPWS Drone Exclusion Zone) where rec drone use is prohibited entirely.
permitted_areas: Council-managed land with prior written approval from council
prohibited_areas: NPWS-managed land within the LGA (Ku-ring-gai Chase National Park) — rec use prohibited entirely
Council no-fly zones: swimming pools, school zones, bushcare areas (per RPA policy)
notes: Ku-ring-gai Drone (RPA) Policy (originally adopted 2019, revised v2 considered Nov 2024) governs drone use on council land.

Policy text appears to require written approval for ANY RPA over council land, but cites commercial credentials (RePL/ReOC, public liability insurance) — these don't apply to CASA Part 101 hobbyists, so the rec carve-out needs explicit confirmation.
Application form: Ku-ring-gai Flying of Remotely Piloted Aircraft application form (contact filming@krg.nsw.gov.au or council@krg.nsw.gov.au).
LARGE portion of LGA covered by Ku-ring-gai Chase National Park (NPWS) — rec drone use prohibited (Drone Exclusion Zone).
Always check if your launch/landing point is on NPWS land before flying — many 'council parks' near the national park border are actually NPWS-managed.
Email sent to council 2026-08-09 seeking written confirmation of rec carve-out and no-fly zone list.

north_sydney_council.summary: No dedicated recreational drone policy. CASA recreational rules apply. Most of LGA is within 5.5km of Sydney Airport — CASA restrictions. Email sent to council 2026-08-09 seeking written confirmation of rec carve-out.
